name: How do acrylic bathtubs compare to cast iron models?

mainEntity.name: How do acrylic bathtubs compare to cast iron models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cast iron tubs provide exceptional heat retention, extreme durability, and resistance to scratches, but their heavy weight often demands reinforced floor joists and multiple installers. Acrylic tubs are lightweight, cost-effective, and available in diverse modern shapes, making them much easier to carry upstairs and install. However, acrylic surfaces can scratch more easily if abrasive cleaners are used, and they require a solid mortar support bed during installation to prevent bottom flexing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cast iron holds heat longer and resists scratching but requires heavy floor support; acrylic is lightweight, affordable, and versatile, but needs a stable mortar base.
